extensionMeta.name: MultiUseButton
extensionMeta.description:
Button with a customisable action queue. Actions: Open URL link, set variable, selection, go to sheet, export data of object/sheet, custom api call, App reloads (via Leitart services). Note: selecting dates should be done with selection mode 'values' and type 'number', the value should be a number as well (e.g. =num(today()) )
v1.26.0 (2026-02-27)
